nodes.description: Public owner address of the Ownable contract, set to the deployer and used as the privileged account in the onlyOwner check.
Constructor of the Ownable contract that assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Caller-supplied address used both to initialise owner and inside the onlyOwner modifier guard.
Access-control modifier that reverts when msg.sender is not the stored owner and otherwise continues execution of the guarded function.
Reference to the external NoahToken contract used for balance lookups and token transfers.
Constructor that casts the supplied address parameter into the NoahToken interface stored in noahToken.
Address argument of the NoahDividend constructor that is cast to the NoahToken handle.
Public view helper that returns the NoahToken balance held by a given investor address.
Address argument of balanceOfInvestor forwarded to the external balanceOf call.
Owner-restricted batch distribution function that iterates over investor/amount arrays performing external NoahToken transfers.
Array of recipient addresses used for array allocation, length checks and transfer destinations.
Array of token amounts matched by index with the investors array during the batch transfer loop.
Dynamic address array allocated in multiTransfer that records the successfully transferred recipients.
Loop counter iterating over the investors array in multiTransfer.
Boolean returned by the external NoahToken transfer call, used to decide whether a recipient is recorded.
External call noahToken.transfer(investors[i], tokenAmounts[i]) executed inside a loop while contract state is being modified, exposing an external-call/reentrancy surface.
revert() executed in the onlyOwner modifier when msg.sender does not match owner, enforcing the access-control restriction.
revert() executed when the investors/tokenAmounts arrays are empty or have mismatched lengths.
External static call noahToken.balanceOf(investor) whose result is returned directly to the caller.

edges.reason: The Ownable constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
Untrusted msg.sender is stored as the privileged owner, defining the authorization principal.
The untrusted msg.sender is compared against owner, driving the onlyOwner revert branch.
The stored owner state variable is read to validate the caller inside the onlyOwner modifier.
The onlyOwner modifier gates entry into multiTransfer, restricting the batch transfer to the owner.
Execution of the onlyOwner modifier branches into the revert() guard when the caller is not owner.
The constructor parameter noahTokenAddress is cast and assigned to the noahToken state variable.
The NoahDividend constructor writes the NoahToken reference into noahToken.
The investor parameter is forwarded as the argument of the external balanceOf call.
balanceOfInvestor invokes the external noahToken.balanceOf call and returns its value.
multiTransfer executes the external token transfer inside its loop, giving the callee control before the batch completes.
Recipient addresses taken from the untrusted investors array are passed into the external transfer call.
Token amounts taken from the tokenAmounts array are passed as the value argument of the external transfer.
The length of the investors array is compared with tokenAmounts length before any transfer is performed.
The loop counter i selects the investor/amount pair used in each external transfer call.
The loop counter indexes the investors array to obtain each recipient.
The boolean returned by the external transfer call is captured in the result local variable.
A successful transfer result causes the corresponding recipient to be written into the results array.
The recipient address from investors is stored into the results array on success.
multiTransfer allocates, populates and returns the results address array.
multiTransfer reverts when the input arrays are empty or their lengths do not match.
The investors array length feeds the validation condition that triggers revert().
The tokenAmounts array length feeds the validation condition that triggers revert().

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter only exists to initialise the noahToken state variable inside NoahDividend's constructor.
The investor parameter is a transient input of balanceOfInvestor forwarded to the external balanceOf call.
The investors array is a transient input consumed entirely by the multiTransfer batch loop.
The tokenAmounts array is a transient input consumed entirely by the multiTransfer batch loop.
The results array is a locally allocated return buffer of multiTransfer and carries no independent semantics.
The loop counter i is a purely local iteration index of the multiTransfer loop.
The result boolean is a purely local sink for the return value of the external noahToken.transfer call.
